record.paper_title: Unsolved Problems in Visibility Graphs of Points, Segments and Polygons
record.original_question: For all integers k ≥ 2 and ℓ ≥ 2, does there exist an integer h(k, ℓ) such that every planar point set of at least h(k, ℓ) points contains either ℓ collinear points or k mutually visible points?

evidence.quote: Open Problem 6 Prove Conjecture 2 for k = 6 or ℓ = 4.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $P$ be a finite set of points in the Euclidean plane $\mathbb{R}^2$. Two points $p,q\in P$ are said to be mutually visible (with respect to $P$) if the open line segment between $p$ and $q$ contains no point of $P$. A subset $C\subseteq P$ is called a visibility clique if every two points of $C$ are mutually visible. A subset $L\subseteq P$ is called collinear if all its points lie on a common straight line.

Prove or disprove: for every pair of integers $k\ge 2$ and $\ell\ge 2$, there exists an integer $h(k,\ell)$ such that every set $P\subset\mathbb{R}^2$ with $|P|\ge h(k,\ell)$ contains either $\ell$ collinear points or a visibility clique of size $k$.
artifact.status_search_result: The big-line-big-clique conjecture remains open in general for finite point sets. It is known to hold when k=3 or ℓ=3, when k=4 (any ℓ), and when k=5 (any ℓ≥4); it is open for all k≥6. A strengthened "visible islands" variant has been disproved, and the conjecture is also known to fail for infinite point sets (Pór–Wood, 2010).

status_evidence.title: Big-line-big-clique conjecture - Wikipedia
status_evidence.snippet: The conjecture holds when k = 3 or ℓ = 3... holds when k = 4... verified for k = 5 and ℓ≥4. The conjecture remains open for all k ≥6 and ℓ≥4.
status_evidence.claim: Conjecture verified for k≤5; open for k≥6.

status_evidence.title: The Big-Line-Big-Clique Conjecture is False for Infinite Point Sets
status_evidence.snippet: Pór and Wood constructed a countably infinite point set with no four collinear and no three pairwise visible points.
status_evidence.claim: Conjecture fails for infinite point sets.

status_evidence.title: Big Line or Big Clique in Planar Point Sets - Open Problem Garden
status_evidence.snippet: Listed as an open problem in discrete geometry.
